applies_to: first air-water heat pump incl. hybrid, owner-occupier (ISDE)

rules.status: announced, not final; hybrid treatment unconfirmed
rules.transition: bought on/before 2026-12-31 and installed in 2027 keeps 2026 rate; proof: signed quote or order confirmation

exclusions: split unit with refrigerant charge < 3 kg and GWP > 750 (from 2026)
note: kW = subsidiable kW from the RVO meldcode list, may differ from marketed kW (e.g. KA21789 Quatt Hybrid 6kW = 4 kW, EUR 2125 in 2026)
